searchText: A short summary of any decisions from testing calls is sufficient. Can be posted here and I can share on Eth Magicians. Any discussions/decisions that need to be made in public can be picked up by ACD. I think it's already just testing + implimenters that showed up, so you should be able to provide any take freely. Agreed with the sentiment though 😄
